default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-768.title: Time-of-day drift persistence
E-768.hypothesis: At a given minute of the day the next bar has leaned the same way on most of the last 20 sessions (scheduled flows: fixings, futures-roll hedges, foreign desks); trade the lean when its t-stat is high.

E-769.title: Day-open recross follow
E-769.hypothesis: After the price spends a while on one side of the session open, a close back across it flips the day's winners and losers; follow the cross.

E-770.title: Dry-volume new extreme fade
E-770.hypothesis: A new session high/low printed on well below usual volume has no real participation behind it; fade it.

E-771.title: Impulse bar half-retrace resume
E-771.hypothesis: After an unusually large bar, a pullback to its midpoint that closes back past it shows the impulse holders are still in control; resume in the impulse direction.

E-772.title: Sloping-VWAP pullback
E-772.hypothesis: When the session VWAP itself is clearly rising or falling, institutional average-price buyers/sellers defend it; the first touch that closes back on the trend side is a continuation entry.

E-773.title: Accelerating-body momentum
E-773.hypothesis: Consecutive same-colour bars with growing bodies show urgency that has not yet been met by opposing flow; follow the acceleration.

E-774.title: Prior-close location bias
E-774.hypothesis: A day that closed in the top (bottom) of its range leaves overnight/opening bias in that direction; in the morning, a cross of the prior close in that direction is followed.

E-775.title: Hourly opening-range break
E-775.hypothesis: Order flow resets on the hour (scheduled data, desk shifts); a close beyond the first minutes' range of the hour is followed.

E-776.title: Stall bar after a run fade
E-776.hypothesis: After a run, a bar with a much smaller range than the recent average shows the aggressive side has run out of fuel; fade the run.

E-777.title: Higher-high higher-low staircase
E-777.hypothesis: A staircase of N bars each making both a higher high and a higher low (or lower/lower) is an orderly trend with no overlap for counter-traders; follow it.
